test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. He stamped them mechanically and returned them to us.

B. They had information that large sums of money were being smuggled out of the country.

C. No sooner had he left than the custom officers entered.

D. An official entered our train compartment and asked for passports.
solution:
The correct answer is '**DACB**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a** para jumbled question** is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
 
• **Sentence D** will be the first sentence because it is the starting of an incident.
 
• After it, **Sentence A** will be used because it is connected with **Sentence A** which talks about the passport.
 
• **Sentence C** will be the next sentence because it tells us when custom officers entered.
 
• Lastly, **Sentence B **will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **D**: An official entered our train compartment and asked for passports.
 
• **A**: He stamped them mechanically and returned them to us.
 
• **C**: No sooner had he left than the custom officers entered.
 
• **B**: They had information that large sums of money were being smuggled out of the country.

 
 
 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *An official entered our train compartment and asked for passports. He stamped them mechanically and returned them to us. No sooner had he left than the custom officers entered. They had information that large sums of money were being smuggled out of the country.*
